author: dmaretskyi
principle: Avoid scanning a data structure's full history when only a cheap, incremental check is needed.
fix_shape: compute the value from the latest heads/changes instead of scanning from the beginning.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Use the project's shared test database/service layer instead of hand-rolling an in-memory mock for the same dependency.
fix_shape: replace the custom mock/layer construction with the existing shared test layer.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Use the project's shared test database/service layer instead of hand-rolling an in-memory mock for the same dependency.
fix_shape: replace the custom mock/layer construction with the existing shared test layer.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Put a generic, domain-agnostic helper in the shared utility package it belongs to, not in a domain-specific package's public export list.
fix_shape: move the helper to the shared package (e.g. the effect/schema utils package) and re-export from there.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Before exporting a new function, check whether an existing function already provides the same capability and reuse it instead of adding a near-duplicate.
fix_shape: replace the new export with the existing equivalent function.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Do not expose a private/internal implementation symbol through the public API; consumers should go through the intended public factory function.
fix_shape: remove the internal export and route callers through the public factory (e.g. Annotation.make).

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Do not expose a private/internal implementation symbol through the public API; consumers should go through the intended public factory function.
fix_shape: remove the internal export and route callers through the public factory (e.g. Annotation.make).

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Do not re-export internal implementation details from a package's public entry point; keep them under the package's internal subpath.
fix_shape: remove the exports from the public module, keeping them under /internal.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Before adding a new export, check whether the same type/value is already exported under a different name and reuse that instead of duplicating it.
fix_shape: remove the duplicate export and point callers at the existing one.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Before adding a new export, check whether the same type/value is already exported under a different name and reuse that instead of duplicating it.
fix_shape: remove the duplicate export and point callers at the existing one.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: A field restricted to a fixed set of valid values should be validated against a single canonical, enumerated definition of that set, not left as an unconstrained string.
fix_shape: define and reference a canonical enum/registry of the valid values rather than a free-form field.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Store per-entity state on the entity's own record rather than in a side map keyed by entity id.
fix_shape: move the map-tracked state onto a field of the entity/record itself.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: When code moves to a new location, update every import to the new location rather than adding a re-export shim at the old one.
fix_shape: delete the re-export and update all call sites to import from the new module.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: When code moves to a new location, update every import to the new location rather than adding a re-export shim at the old one.
fix_shape: delete the re-export and update all call sites to import from the new module.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Before adding a new module, check whether an equivalent already exists elsewhere in the codebase and reuse or extend it instead of duplicating it.
fix_shape: consolidate the new module with the existing equivalent instead of introducing a parallel one.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Export a value with a composed/inferred type through an opaque type wrapper rather than the raw inferred type, so d.ts emission doesn't need to portably name a complex cross-package inferred type.
fix_shape: wrap the export with an opaque-type helper (e.g. an `.opaque` pattern) instead of exposing the raw inferred type.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Merge two near-identical types that differ only by a state/flag into a single type instead of keeping parallel near-duplicate types.
fix_shape: combine the two types into one, parameterized by the differing field.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Place tests that exercise the full stack in the e2e test package and use the shared test database layer, rather than hand-rolled fixtures in a unit-test file.
fix_shape: move the suite to the e2e package and swap the ad hoc fixture for the shared test layer.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Before adding a new module for a capability, check whether it fits into an existing module by precedent and add it there instead.
fix_shape: add the new accessor/helper to the existing module that already houses similar ones, following its precedent.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: When a lower-level primitive package already exists for a concern, add new low-level functionality there instead of introducing a parallel implementation in a different package.
fix_shape: move the new low-level implementation into the existing dedicated package.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Give a shared prototype/behavior object a precise type (not a loose `object`) so its methods receive a correctly typed `this`.
fix_shape: replace the loose `object` type annotation with a proper interface/class type.

author: richburdon
principle: When a lower-level primitive package already exists for a concern, add new low-level functionality there instead of introducing a parallel implementation in a different package.
fix_shape: move the new low-level implementation into the existing dedicated package.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Before adding special-case handling for something, check whether an existing resolver/service already performs it and move the logic there instead of duplicating it.
fix_shape: move the branching logic into the existing resolver and remove the ad hoc duplicate path.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Prefer real methods on the owning prototype/class (using true #private state) over free functions that reach into an object's internals via exported symbols.
fix_shape: convert the free functions into prototype methods with private fields.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: When the same block of logic recurs across call sites, extract it into a single method on the object that owns the underlying state, rather than repeating it.
fix_shape: extract the repeated branching into one shared method (e.g. on ObjectCore) and call it from each site.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Remove a now-redundant convenience function once its behavior is fully covered by a newer unified API, rather than keeping both.
fix_shape: delete the old function and migrate its callers to the new shorthand.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Keep implementation-detail helpers that are not part of the intended public contract out of the public API surface; place them in the internal module.
fix_shape: move the helper into the internal directory instead of exporting it publicly.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Prefer expressing new functionality through the existing API surface rather than adding a new method when the existing primitives can already support it.
fix_shape: implement the feature by composing existing API calls instead of adding a new method.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: When a dependency or subsystem is removed, check for and remove modules that existed only to support it.
fix_shape: delete the module once confirmed the supporting dependency/subsystem is gone.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Prefer the simplest primitive that achieves the goal over introducing a more complex abstraction when the added complexity isn't needed by callers.
fix_shape: replace the paged-window API with a simpler count-based `loadNext(count)` call.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Store data that needs to be queried independently as its own object/type rather than inlining it inside another object, so it can be queried without loading the container.
fix_shape: split the field out into a separate ECHO object type that can be queried on its own.
